name: Yoneda Shiori
source:
She is a nurse at Jomiya General Hospital. She is a lesbian, and she calls Rumi Iwasaki “big sister”.

Sakaguchi takes advantage of her sexuality and uses her for his own purpose.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1327]Getchu[/url]]
